raw.title: Customer Integration Engineer
raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Application Engineering Team(s)

We’re seeking an exceptional Customer Integration Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting our customers throughout the entire development lifecycle, from the initial integration phase to the final validation of our technology. You will ensure that customers receive responsive, high-quality technical support and work closely with both our clients and internal engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of our technology into their vehicles.

Located near our customers, you will be in a prime position to perform rapid diagnostics, identify issues in real time, and collaborate directly with customer engineering teams. This proximity allows you to maintain a holistic understanding of the system and effectively distinguish between vehicle-related issues and those specific to the Wayve AI Driver.

 
 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Provide hands-on technical support to customers throughout the development and validation process

  • Serve as the bridge between customer vehicle integration teams and Wayve’s internal engineering teams

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to our technology independently

  • Escalate complex or critical issues to the appropriate internal stakeholders

  • Develop deep understanding of customer systems and APIs (e.g. drive-by-wire) to effectively guide internal teams

  • Maintain a system-level perspective to identify root causes, whether vehicle-based or software-related

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking

  • Proven ability to lead investigations into platform or vehicle issues in collaboration with internal and customer teams
    Extensive hands-on experience with development vehicles

  • Proficiency with diagnostic and calibration tools (e.g. CANape or similar)

  • Familiarity with terminal usage and a willingness to develop basic programming skills

  • Solid understanding of vehicle communication protocols (e.g. CAN, Ethernet) and automotive system architectures

  • Practical experience working in an automotive environment, ideally with a track record of bringing products to production

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with both customers and internal teams

  • Willingness to travel as required

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews [Integration Competency, 60mins]

  • Deep-dive technical interviews [Vehicle Integration, 60mins, Automotive, 60mins]

  • Final interview: [Mission & Values alignment, 30mins].

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

raw.title: Test Engineer
raw.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Test Engineer Teams

We’re seeking an exceptional Test Engineer to join our Germany-based team focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Test Engineer, you'll independently own the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack. You'll build robust, reusable test automation, drive failures to root cause across engineering boundaries, and steadily raise the bar on coverage, reliability, and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system including sensing and model-behaviour testing as the company and your experience evolve. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement across multiple engineering domains.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration, and system levels, across software and hardware boundaries.

  • Automate open-loop and closed-loop replay based Tests, reliability and fault-injection tests to support verification, release, coverage expansion, and debug workflows.

  • Lead root-cause investigations for failures found during test campaigns, collaborating across hardware, software, and infrastructure teams.

  • Optimise buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable, and repeatable execution.

  • Integrate third-party verification tools including JAMA (requirements), MC/DC (coverage), and MISRA (style compliance); manage artefacts via Artifactory and Azure.

  • Define and track KPIs and quality metrics for system testing, supporting data-driven validation and release decisions.

  • Uncover software and hardware bugs through increased test coverage and report findings through JIRA.

  • Identify and implement infrastructure improvements that enhance test coverage, failure traceability, and compliance reporting.

  • Review, create, and adhere to Risk Assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software, or mechatronic systems, with a track record of delivering test automation independently.

  • Experience with L2+ hands-off, L3, or L4 automated driving systems.

  • Knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols (e.g., Euro NCAP -AEB, LSS/LKA, ADAS scenarios), DCAS regulatory testing (UN R171), and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards (ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155).

  • Experience with HiL testing and tooling using CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, dSPACE, Vector, Xylon, or similar.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, including developing automation test frameworks with pytest.

  • Proven ability in interface-level testing, including hardware/software interactions and embedded interfaces.

  • Experience integrating software quality assurance tools and standards (ASPICE, SOTIF, ISO 26262, JAMA, X-RAY).

  • Knowledge of open- and closed-loop HiL replay using dSPACE or other emulators.

  • Proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling (e.g., GitLab CI, Buildkite, Bazel).

  • Experience with test automation dashboards, logging, and reporting infrastructure (e.g., Grafana, Looker, Datadog, JIRA).

  • Experience developing or testing automotive software across embedded and system levels.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills; able to work collaboratively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps, and product teams.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience with autonomous vehicle systems, ADAS, or related technologies..

  • Strong Python Automation and knowledge of dSPACE open and closed Loop HIL based replay Testing

  • Experience contributing to continuous improvement of test methods, safety procedures, or operational efficiency.

  • Awareness of data management and version control systems (e.g., Git, Buildkite, or similar).

  • Familiarity with agentic AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and a demonstrated ability to use them to accelerate and optimise test development, debugging, and automation workflows.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews [Python Programming, 60mins]

  • Deep-dive technical interviews [System Design, Validation & Release, 60mins, Cross Functional Collaboration, 60mins]

  • Final interview: [Mission & Values alignment, 30mins].

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. Als Senior Quality Engineer – Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden. Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Quality Operations innerhalb von Delivery Excellence und arbeitest eng mit den Teams Checkout & Payments, dem Produktmanagement und weiteren Quality Engineers zusammen. Du bringst Qualität früh in die Feature-Planung ein, überführst Produktrisiken in ausführbare Tests, untersuchst Fehler und gibst klare Empfehlungen zur Release-Bereitschaft. Die Position ist eine Senior-Engineering-Rolle ohne Führungsverantwortung. Du entwickelst das bestehende Framework für Abnahmetests und die CI-Infrastruktur weiter, statt eine separate Testorganisation aufzubauen. Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung. Automatisierte Tests entwickeln und pflegen. Nutze TypeScript, Playwright sowie API- und Integrationstests, um das Verhalten im Storefront, in Shopware, im Payments-Service und an den Schnittstellen zu Zahlungsanbietern zu prüfen. Wähle die passende Testebene, statt jede Prüfung in einem Browser-Test abzubilden. Zahlungsergebnisse prüfen, nicht nur das UI-Verhalten. Kontrolliere Bestellerstellung, Zahlungsstatus, Beträge und Währungen. Ergänze die Testabdeckung entsprechend dem Produktrisiko um relevante Szenarien zu Stornierung, Einzug, Rückerstattung, Webhooks und Wiederherstellung. Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen. Testergebnisse für die Auslieferung nutzbar machen. Integriere und pflege Produkttests gemeinsam mit Engineering und Product Operations in der CI. Verbessere Testdaten, Wiederholbarkeit und Diagnosemöglichkeiten. Unterscheide zwischen Produktfehlern, Problemen bei Zahlungsanbietern oder Umgebungen und instabilen Tests. Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen. Eine klare QA-Empfehlung kommunizieren. Erläutere gegenüber Product und Engineering den geprüften Umfang, die Ergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken, Blocker und nächsten Schritte. Sprich Prioritätskonflikte frühzeitig an und begleite offene Punkte bis zu ihrer Lösung, einer vereinbarten Übergabe oder einer klaren Entscheidung. Verantwortung und Wissen teilen. Prüfe Testcode, arbeite mit Kolleg:innen im Pairing und verbessere gemeinsam nutzbare Fixtures und Dokumentation. Stimme dich mit anderen Quality Engineers ab, damit die Testabdeckung von mehreren Personen gepflegt und unterstützt werden kann. Das bringst du mit: Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Tests für produktive Software, einschließlich API- und Integrationstests sowie End-to-End-Tests. Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaScript und praktische Erfahrung mit Playwright oder einem vergleichbaren Framework. Du kannst sicher in einer Playwright-basierten Codebasis arbeiten. Erfahrung mit CI-Pipelines, Git, Code-Reviews, reproduzierbaren Testumgebungen und der Fehlersuche mithilfe von Logs, Traces und Anwendungscode. Verständnis von HTTP-APIs, Authentifizierung, asynchroner Verarbeitung und Zustandsübergängen – einschließlich der Frage, wie sich Fehler- und Wiederholungsverhalten testen lässt. Die Fähigkeit, unklare Produktanforderungen in testbare Szenarien zu übersetzen, nach Risiko zu priorisieren und sinnvolle Arbeitsschritte umzusetzen – und bei Bedarf Unterstützung einzuholen. Eine kooperative Haltung: Du arbeitest gern im Team, lernst neugierig von anderen und gibst dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung gern weiter. Klare mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation auf Englisch sowie Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Entwickler:innen und Produktkolleg:innen zu Qualitätsrisiken und Release-Entscheidungen. Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Zahlungsanbietern, E-Commerce oder Finanztransaktionen ist hilfreich. Ebenso willkommen sind Kenntnisse in PHP/Symfony, Shopware, API-Vertragstests auf OpenAPI-Basis, containerisierten Umgebungen oder mandantenfähigen Services. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungs- und Testwerkzeugen ist ebenfalls willkommen, sofern die Ergebnisse eigenständig geprüft und verifiziert werden. Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in jedem der genannten Bereiche Erfahrung mitbringen, um dich zu bewerben. Kenntnisse in Shopware oder PayPal sind keine Voraussetzung. Woran Erfolg gemessen wird: Deine ersten Prioritäten legst du während des Onboardings gemeinsam mit Product, Engineering und dem Quality-Engineering-Team fest. Dazu gehören: Eine aktuelle Übersicht der kritischen Payments-Abläufe, der bestehenden Testabdeckung und der wichtigsten Lücken – mit klar zugeordneten Umsetzungsverantwortlichkeiten. Ein erster Kauf- und Zahlungsablauf, der zuverlässig in der CI oder innerhalb eines vereinbarten Release-Gates ausgeführt wird, das Bestell- und Zahlungsergebnis prüft und aussagekräftige Hinweise bei Fehlern liefert. Eine risikobasierte Testabdeckung für weitere Integrationen und Ausbaustufen des New Checkout – mit klaren QA-Empfehlungen, dokumentierten Einschränkungen und gemeinsamer Verantwortung für die Pflege der Tests. Der Fortschritt wird anhand der tatsächlich funktionierenden Testabdeckung, der Zuverlässigkeit der Tests und der Aussagekraft von Release-Entscheidungen bewertet – nicht allein anhand der Anzahl der Tests oder des Umfangs der Dokumentation. Das bieten wir dir: Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert. Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge. Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware. Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy". Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung. Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents. ... und vieles mehr!   • Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen.   • Automatisierte Tests entwickeln und pflegen.   • Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen.

  • Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen.

raw.title: Security Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Baue eine dauerhafte Product-Security-Engineering-Funktion für die Shopware-Produkte auf. Das Team verhindert wiederkehrende Schwachstellenklassen, schafft klare Zuständigkeiten und Reaktionszeiten für Sicherheitsaufgaben und unterstützt die Produktteams dabei, Risiken zu beheben, bevor daraus Sicherheitsvorfälle mit Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden entstehen.

Product Security Engineering ist von der bestehenden SecOps- bzw. Information-Security-Funktion abgegrenzt. Die Funktion verantwortet die Ergebnisse im Bereich Product Security Engineering und das Betriebsmodell für diese Arbeit. Sie ersetzt weder die Governance durch InfoSec noch die Verantwortung der Engineering-Domänen, die Freigabe durch Quality oder Product Operations.


  • Entwickle und leite eine risikobasierte Product-Security-Roadmap für Commerce Core, Services und weitere Produktbereiche. Sorge für eine ausgewogene Gewichtung von Prävention, Erkennung, Incident-Bereitschaft und Behebung.

  • Verantworte das Modell für Eingang und Triage von Product-Security-Findings aus externen Meldungen, Bug-Bounty-Programmen, Penetrationstests, Dependency-Sicherheitshinweisen, internen Entdeckungen und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen. Vereinbare Schweregrade und Reaktionsziele mit den Domänenverantwortlichen und InfoSec, leite jeden Vorgang an den zuständigen Code Owner weiter und mache die laufenden Reaktionsfristen sichtbar.

  • Arbeite selbst aktiv mit: Erstelle Threat Models für sicherheitskritische Änderungen, prüfe risikoreiche Designs, untersuche Schwachstellen und implementiere besonders wirksame Sicherheitskontrollen in gemeinsam genutzten Produktkomponenten oder entwickle sie gemeinsam mit anderen.

  • Etabliere wiederholbare Vorgehensweisen für sicheres Design, Sicherheitsreviews, Tests von Missbrauchsszenarien, Dependency- und Code-Scanning, die Offenlegung von Schwachstellen und Incident-Bereitschaft.

  • Koordiniere produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit über eine vereinbarte Dokumentation: GHSA für Angaben zur Offenlegung, ein privates GitHub-Issue oder Epic für Fixes und Backports sowie eine Confluence-Seite zum Sicherheitsvorfall oder Release für Rollen, Entscheidungen, QA-Status und Kommunikationsbereitschaft. Nutze Slack für die operative Abstimmung und verlinke getroffene Entscheidungen zurück in die Dokumentation.

  • Weise gemeinsam mit den Engineering Leads jedem bestätigten Problem eine technisch verantwortliche Person und einen Fälligkeitstermin zu. Eskaliere blockierte Behebungen und verbleibende Risiken über die etablierten Entscheidungswege von Product, InfoSec und der Führungsebene.

  • Verbessere die Sicherheitsabdeckung für unterstützte Versionen und zugehörige Produkte, darunter das Security Plugin, Commercial-Komponenten, Services sowie relevante App- und Extension-Schnittstellen.

  • Leite die technische Aufarbeitung nach Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases. Überführe Ursachen in konkrete Präventionsmaßnahmen mit klarer Verantwortung, Tests, Tools oder Designänderungen und verfolge, ob diese Änderungen Wiederholungen reduzieren.

  • Fördere und entwickle die beiden Engineers weiter, stelle die Abdeckung von Commerce Core und Services sicher und mache die Arbeit des Teams in der Produktplanung sichtbar.

  • Arbeite mit InfoSec, Product Operations, Quality Operations, DevRel, Legal, Customer Support und der Product-Leitung an Entscheidungen zu Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Reaktionen, Releases und Kommunikation.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Verbesserung der Sicherheit produktiv eingesetzter Produkte.

  • Praktische Kenntnisse in der Anwendungssicherheit, insbesondere zu Authentifizierung, Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, sicheren Integrationen und gängigen Schwachstellenklassen.

  • Erfahrung darin, Schwachstellenmeldungen zu untersuchen und daraus einen getesteten und priorisierten Behebungsplan für mehrere Teams oder unterstützte Versionen zu entwickeln.

  • Die Fähigkeit, direkt mit Code und Tests zu arbeiten und Sicherheitstools wie SAST, Dependency Scanning, Fuzzing oder Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien einzusetzen und zu verbessern.

  • Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Ausnutzbarkeit, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden, Schweregrad, koordinierter Offenlegung und Incident Response.

  • Klare technische Dokumentation und souveräne, ruhige Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams bei dringenden und unklaren Aufgaben.

  • Erfahrung darin, Engineers zu fördern oder ein kleines technisches Team zu leiten. Formale Personalverantwortung ist hilfreich; technische Führung und Coaching sind wesentlich.

  • Kenntnisse von Open-Source-Produkten, Extension-Ökosystemen, Cloud-Services und Release-Modellen mit mehreren unterstützten Versionen sind von Vorteil.

Woran du deinen Erfolg erkennst:

  • Für Product-Security-Findings gibt es einen einheitlichen Eingang, eine namentlich benannte technische Verantwortung, einen Schweregrad, ein Reaktionsziel und einen sichtbaren Abschlussnachweis.

  • Sicherheitsarbeit ist mit klaren Abwägungen und Eskalationswegen in der Planung vertreten, wenn sie mit bereits zugesagter Produktarbeit konkurriert.

  • Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel wissen, wo Product Security Engineering die Führung übernimmt und wofür die jeweiligen Partner verantwortlich bleiben.

join the team

Du willst in den Social Commerce einsteigen und von Tag eins an Verantwortung übernehmen? Als Werki TikTok Shop Management lernst du bei uns, wie man Creator Communities für unsere Kunden aufbaut und skaliert. Du wirst Schritt für Schritt an eigene Kunden herangeführt und wächst mit deinen Aufgaben.

TikTok Shop verändert gerade den gesamten Social Commerce, und wir sind von Anfang an dabei. Als eine der führenden TikTok Shop Agenturen in Deutschland bauen wir Creator-Netzwerke, die nicht nur Content produzieren, sondern echten Umsatz treiben. Wenn du “Driving the future of Social Commerce by building and scaling high-performance TikTok Shop strategies” liest und denkst “Oh yes, ich möchte Teil der Journey werden”, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

der task

Creator Sourcing & Onboarding

  • Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und Ausbau des TikTok Shop Affiliate Netzwerks unserer Kunden.
  • Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Creator, die zur Brand, zur Zielgruppe und zum Produkt passen.
  • Du behältst die Top Creator pro Kunde im Blick und hilfst dabei, sie langfristig zu halten.
  • Du begleitest den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess: von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Vertragsabwicklung bis zum ersten Posting.
  • Du entwickelst ein Gespür dafür, welcher Creator zu welcher Brand passt und welcher nicht.

Creator Management & Kommunikation

  • Du wirst Ansprechperson für mehrere Affiliates gleichzeitig, hältst die Beziehung warm und gibst klares Feedback.
  • Du erstellst Briefings, die Creator nicht nur informieren, sondern wirklich aktivieren.
  • Du koordinierst Content-Produktionen und achtest auf Output-Qualität und Timelines.

Campaign Management

  • Du planst, setzt auf und wertest Kampagnen für unsere Kunden aus.
  • Du suchst Produkte für die Kampagnen aus und steuerst die Sample-Logistik.
  • Du übersetzt virale Hits auf TikTok Shop in neue Kampagnenideen.

Performance & Optimierung

  • Du trackst die Performance deiner Creator konsequent (GMV, u.v.m.) und lernst, was die Zahlen bedeuten.
  • Du leitest Maßnahmen ab, optimierst das Creator-Setup und skalierst, was funktioniert.
  • Du bringst deine Learnings strukturiert ins Team ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue Standards.

you

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Creator-Umfeld, im Social Media oder Marketing, zum Beispiel durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit, Ausbildung, Studium oder eigene Projekte
  • Echtes Interesse an TikTok, Social Commerce und der Frage, wie Creator Commerce funktioniert (TikTok Shop Vorkenntnisse sind nicht nötig)
  • Organisationstalent: Du behältst den Überblick, auch wenn mehrere Creator, Brands und Deadlines gleichzeitig laufen
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst mit Creatorn auf Augenhöhe und mit Kunden professionell sprechen
  • Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen und nutzt sie, um bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht auf Anleitung, sondern packst an und lernst schnell

das erwartet dich

  • Strukturiertes Onboarding und persönliches Mentoring, damit du schnell sicher wirst und früh eigene Verantwortung übernimmst
  • Ein anspruchsvolles, dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld in einer der führenden und größten Meta & TikTok Performance Marketing Agenturen im deutschsprachigen Raum
  • Zusammenarbeit mit spannenden Brands wie Ankerkraut, More Nutrition, Waterdrop u.v.m.
  • Ein top ausgestattetes TikTok Shop Studio für die Live Streams unserer Kunden
  • Ein dynamisches Team mit starker Hands-on-Mentalität und eigeninitiativer Arbeit
  • 450 qm Loftbüro, lockere Arbeitsatmosphäre und die coolsten Teamevents
  • Die neueste Apple-Technik als Arbeitsausstattung
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Mobility & Sport: KVB JobTicket, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Bikes, Fitnessstudio
  • Feel Good: Warmes Mittagessen, Healthy Snack Bar, Free Drinks & ADBAKER Kaffee, Gaming-Ecke

dein Ansprechpartner

Lukas Hildebrandt
Business Operations Lead

title: Founders Associate Intern (Ops & Marketing)
description: Mercura ( YC W25 ) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months . With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US. About the role We’re looking for a Founder's Associate Intern (Marketing & Ops) to help make Mercura one of the most visible and compelling B2B AI companies in Europe. You will take real ownership of how Mercura shows up externally — to customers, candidates and the broader ecosystem. You’ll work closely with the founders and team to turn ideas, company developments and customer insights into content, campaigns, events and new growth initiatives. This is not an internship where you execute a predefined marketing calendar. We want someone who comes up with ideas, launches them quickly, measures what works and doubles down. If you want to learn how to build a company, enjoy creating things from scratch and care deeply about results, this is an opportunity to own a meaningful part of Mercura from day one. What you will be working on Company & Founder Marketing: Own and grow Mercura's company and founder LinkedIn presence. Turn what happens inside Mercura into content that reaches prospective customers, exceptional candidates and the wider industry. Growth Marketing: Develop and test new ways to generate awareness, inbound demand and talent. Come up with experiments, launch them quickly and measure whether they actually move the numbers. SEO, AI Visibility & Website: Help grow Mercura's organic presence across Google and AI search. Work with experienced external experts on SEO, AI visibility, website structure, conversion and design — and turn their recommendations into execution. Events: Build memorable events for both customers and talent — from recruiting events and community formats to intimate dinners with CEOs and strategic prospects. Own everything from the initial idea and guest list to invitations and execution. Brand & Content: Create landing pages, customer stories, campaigns, event concepts and other assets that make Mercura stand out and explain why what we are building matters. New Initiatives: Spot opportunities we haven't thought of yet. If you believe a campaign, partnership, event or completely different idea could create meaningful impact, you will have the freedom to make it happen. What we’re looking for Skills & Experience You have already gained hands-on marketing experience — for example at a startup, through an internship, your own project, student initiative or company. You can write exceptionally well and understand what makes people stop, read and take action. You have a strong instinct for content, positioning and what makes a company or person interesting. You combine creativity with commercial thinking. You care about reach, qualified leads, great applicants and actual outcomes , not just producing content. You are comfortable using AI tools and learn new tools extremely quickly. You take full ownership. If something needs to happen, you figure out how to make it happen rather than waiting for instructions. Your German is C2/native-level. This is a hard requirement. You are also a strong professional communicator in English. Personality & Commitment You’re entrepreneurial, ambitious and highly proactive. You have strong drive and hold yourself to a high standard. You enjoy starting with a blank page and turning an idea into something real. You are creative, but equally comfortable with execution and the unglamorous details required to make something successful. You are highly organized and can run several initiatives simultaneously without losing speed. You care about results and naturally ask: Did this actually work? How can we make it better? You want to work in person in Munich and thrive in an environment with significantly higher intensity and ownership than a typical 9–5 internship. Availability You are available for a minimum 4-month full-time internship . Ideally, you are in the final semester of your Bachelor's or Master's degree , or have recently graduated. We are explicitly looking for people who could imagine staying at Mercura afterwards. If there is a strong mutual fit, there is an opportunity to transition into a full-time role . Why Mercura Learn how to build a company: You’ll work close to the founders and see how decisions are made across growth, product, sales, hiring and company building — while owning projects yourself. Real ownership: You won’t just support marketing. You will own initiatives end-to-end and have the freedom to propose and build things that don't exist yet. An unusually steep learning curve: You’ll work across content, growth, brand, events, SEO, AI visibility and operations rather than spending months on one narrow internship project. Exceptional people around you: Work alongside experienced operators, ex-founders, engineers and top graduates from companies and universities such as Google, Bain, MIT, TUM, Harvard, CDTM and Cambridge. Build something with real-world impact: Mercura brings modern AI into industries that still rely heavily on emails, PDFs, phone calls and manual ERP processes. Tools without bureaucracy: Get access to the AI, marketing and productivity tools you need to do great work, as well as expert support where it helps you move faster. The everyday: Free team dinners, UrbanSportsClub membership, team workouts and support relocating to Munich. About the process Step 1: Intro Call A short conversation to get to know each other and tell you more about Mercura and the role. Step 2: Practical Marketing Case A practical exercise around a real Mercura marketing challenge. We care much more about how you think, create and execute than theoretical marketing knowledge. Step 3: Offer If there is a strong mutual fit, we'll make you an offer. About the Founders We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean , the co-founders of Mercura. We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible. Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility. Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI. Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs. Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences. Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations. Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry. At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins. Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others. raw.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

description: Rudi is building the AI knowledge and decision layer for the skilled trades. Today, diagnosing a technical fault often depends on who happens to be on site. Experienced Meisters rely on years of tacit knowledge, technical documentation and intuition. Less experienced technicians frequently need additional visits or senior support. Rudi makes that expertise available to every technician and across trades. Our AI assistant guides technicians through diagnosis and repair, combines manufacturer knowledge with real service experience, and learns from the outcome of every job. Our ambition is to make every technician perform closer to the best Meister in the organisation — and ultimately build the intelligence layer for technical field services across the skilled trades. Rudi is being built with Founders Factory and a large European residential and field service organisation. The first product is already being tested with experienced Meisters, with live field pilots starting shortly. The role Your mission is to validate Rudi's commercial potential beyond our launch partner, identify promising customer segments and build an initial sales pipeline. This is a hands-on role focused on customer outreach, commercial validation and early sales opportunities — not a desk research or purely strategic consulting assignment. We're looking for someone who is comfortable approaching new customers, testing commercial assumptions and turning conversations into concrete next steps. What you will own Customer outreach & commercial validation. Identify and engage potential customers across housing companies, technical service providers and installation businesses. Understand their operational challenges, buying processes and willingness to pay. Build an initial sales pipeline. Reach relevant decision-makers, run discovery and sales conversations, and develop promising contacts into concrete pilot or commercial opportunities. GTM strategy & business case. Identify priority customer segments, test pricing and positioning, and develop a pragmatic GTM recommendation supported by a credible customer ROI case. What we are looking for You are commercially sharp, entrepreneurial and comfortable operating in the uncertainty of an early-stage startup. You know how to develop a sales strategy, but more importantly, you know how to execute it. You are a team player who enjoys a collaborative environment and working together with the co-founder team that is developing Rudi. You bring: Proven B2B sales and GTM experience, ideally gained in early-stage startups or through consulting assignments with multiple startups. A track record of conducting external commercial validation, building sales pipelines and winning early customers for new products. The ability to identify and engage senior decision-makers, navigate complex B2B buying processes and turn initial interest into concrete commercial opportunities. A genuine interest in AI and the curiosity to track what others in the space are building. You like to follow the market, and not just focus on your own pipeline. Strong commercial and analytical skills, including pricing, business modelling and customer economics. A hands-on, independent working style. You take ownership, move fast and don't need a fully developed playbook to get started. Native or near-native German and fluent English. Experience in enterprise SaaS, AI, field services, property management, building technology or the skilled trades would be a plus. The engagement Type: Freelance / independent consultant Start: As soon as possible Duration: Until mid-December 2026, with potential to extend Compensation: competitive, based on experience & industry fit Commitment: Ideally 2–4 days per week Location: Berlin/hybrid, with occasional travel for customer and partner meetings Team: Work directly with Rudi's founders, supported by Founders Factory . title: GTM & Growth Engineer
description: Your Mission Cosuno is a platform for construction tendering in the German-speaking market. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. As our GTM & Growth Engineer, you build the automation and data behind marketing and growth. You find where work is manual or where data goes unused, build a solution that works in one area, such as paid marketing, lifecycle, sales handovers or content, and then reuse it across the others. You work closely with our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, the Demand Generation Manager and the Marketing Lead, and you ship things with a business outcome attached, not infrastructure for its own sake. You'll be the first engineer in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how our growth stack is built, not just maintain a fixed setup. What you'll do You automate marketing and lifecycle operations: triggers, segments, workflows and personalization in ActiveCampaign and Salesforce, so journeys react to what customers do. You automate paid marketing: audience syncs and suppression from CRM and product data, conversion data fed back to the ad platforms, and campaign feeds and landing pages that adapt to where bids are missing on the Marketplace. Demand Generation owns strategy and budget; you build the machinery. You build the data and signal plumbing: product events, Salesforce, ActiveCampaign, enrichment, transaction history and our BigQuery warehouse, connected, clean and usable. You automate creative production: ad, email and landing-page variants inside our brand templates, with human review before anything goes live. You build once and reuse everywhere: what works in one area becomes a reusable capability for paid, lifecycle, sales and content. You find the manual work and the unused data, such as reporting, list building, call transcripts and enrichment, and replace it with automation and LLM-based tools, including the content engine for SEO and AI search. You give the team fast experimentation: reusable test set-ups, holdouts and measurement, so tests launch in days, not weeks. You launch with care: human checks in every automation, proof against a control or holdout before you scale, and a launch plan with scope, review steps, rollout and rollback. What You Bring You've built marketing or growth automation that runs in production: paid media integrations, CRM and lifecycle workflows, data pipelines, ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business. You're hands-on with APIs, webhooks and automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier or Clay; Python or TypeScript and SQL are a strong plus. You know ad platform and CRM data: audiences, conversion tracking and the limits of attribution. You've shipped LLM-based or agentic automation into a real workflow, not just used AI to write copy faster. You think in outcomes: a working use case in two weeks beats a platform in six months, and you measure what you build. You're careful with what goes live: you check outputs by hand, test against a control before you trust a result, and plan launches step by step with a way back. You work well with marketers and explain trade-offs plainly. Fluent English; German is a plus. Your Benefits Room to shape and grow: The first engineer in Marketing, deciding how our growth stack is built. AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better — and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval. Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours. Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro. A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events. Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations. About us Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology. We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity. Join us – Build the future of construction. title: Head of Data & Analytics (m/w/d)
description: Über Scento Scento ist Europas größte Website für Parfum-Abfüllungen. Das 2024 gegründete Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Paris an der Place Vendôme und ein zweites Büro in Berlin. Scento bietet mehr als 1.000 originale Designer- und Nischendüfte aus einem Portfolio von 200 Parfumhäusern als Abfüllungen an: Fläschchen mit 2 ml, 5 ml und 8 ml sowie bei den meisten Düften eine 30-ml-Flasche. Mit Parfumproben von Nischen- und Designerdüften lässt sich ein Duft entdecken, bevor man sich für einen ganzen Flakon entscheidet. Jedes Parfum ist ein Original von autorisierten europäischen Händlern, und jede Flasche durchläuft vor dem Abfüllen eine 12-Punkte-Eingangsprüfung in Scentos ISO-zertifizierter Einrichtung. Scento beliefert Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten und versendet in 26 EU-Länder. Scentos Jahresumsatz liegt 2026 bei mehr als 30 Millionen Euro, online und offline zusammen. Auf Scento.com war der monatliche Absatz von Abfüllungen im September 2026 3,2-mal so hoch wie im Januar 2026. Nach eigenen Angaben verkauft Scento mehr als 3 Millionen Parfum-Abfüllungen pro Jahr, etwa eine alle 10 Sekunden. Im November 2025 kündigte Scento an, über drei Jahre 25 Millionen Euro in die Entdeckung von Parfum in Europa zu investieren. Deine Rolle Scento verkauft Parfumproben und Abfüllungen an Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten, und fast jede Entscheidung hängt an Zahlen: Wie viel Marketingbudget lohnt sich, welche Düfte gehen aus, welche Kohorten kommen wieder. Als Head of Data & Analytics baust du die Grundlage, auf der diese Entscheidungen fallen. Du verantwortest das Datenfundament von Warehouse und Pipelines bis zu Kennzahlen und Dashboards, entwickelst Modelle für Attribution, LTV und Marge und prognostizierst die Nachfrage gemeinsam mit Operations und Einkauf. Erfolg heißt: Jedes Team arbeitet selbstständig mit Zahlen, denen alle vertrauen. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest Scentos Daten: Warehouse, Pipelines, Metrikdefinitionen und Dashboards. Du baust Attributions-, Kohorten-, LTV- und Margenmodelle, die Marketingausgaben steuern. Du prognostizierst die Nachfrage nach Parfums und Decants gemeinsam mit Operations und Einkauf. Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Team verlässliche Zahlen selbst abrufen und verstehen kann. Du misst die echte Wirkung von Marketing mit Inkrementalitätstests und klaren Experimentdesigns. Du baust die Data-Funktion auf und führst sie mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Tempo. Dein Profil Mindestens 8 Jahre in Analytics oder Data Science, davon mindestens 3 Jahre Führung einer Data-Funktion im E-Commerce oder Consumer-Tech. Exzellentes SQL und Statistik; Erfahrung mit modernen Data Stacks und Produktanalytik. Erfahrung in der Marketingmessung (Inkrementalität, Attribution). Fließend Englisch. Was wir bieten Ein Gehalt am oberen Ende des Marktes plus ein jährlicher Leistungsbonus. Remote-freundlich innerhalb der EU, mit Büros in Paris (Place Vendôme) und Berlin. Ein persönliches Lernbudget von 2.500 € pro Jahr für Kurse, Konferenzen und Bücher. Ein großzügiges monatliches Parfum-Budget, um den gesamten Katalog zu entdecken. Die Ausstattung deiner Wahl und ein Homeoffice-Budget. 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr, zusätzlich zu den gesetzlichen Feiertagen. Echte Verantwortung und schnelle Entscheidungen in einem Unternehmen, das in Europa rasant wächst. Gehalt und Bewerbung Gehalt: 135.000 € bis 175.000 € brutto pro Jahr, Vollzeit, unbefristet, plus ein jährlicher Leistungsbonus. Standort: Berlin oder Paris, alternativ remote aus der gesamten EU. Scento bietet mehr als 1.000 originale Designer- und Nischendüfte aus einem Portfolio von 200 Parfumhäusern als Abfüllungen an: Fläschchen mit 2 ml, 5 ml und 8 ml sowie bei den meisten Düften eine 30-ml-Flasche. Mit Parfumproben von Nischen- und Designerdüften lässt sich ein Duft entdecken, bevor man sich für einen ganzen Flakon entscheidet. Jedes Parfum ist ein Original von autorisierten europäischen Händlern, und jede Flasche durchläuft vor dem Abfüllen eine 12-Punkte-Eingangsprüfung in Scentos ISO-zertifizierter Einrichtung. Scento beliefert Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten und versendet in 26 EU-Länder. Scentos Jahresumsatz liegt 2026 bei mehr als 30 Millionen Euro, online und offline zusammen. Auf Scento.com war der monatliche Absatz von Abfüllungen im September 2026 3,2-mal so hoch wie im Januar 2026. Nach eigenen Angaben verkauft Scento mehr als 3 Millionen Parfum-Abfüllungen pro Jahr, etwa eine alle 10 Sekunden. Im November 2025 kündigte Scento an, über drei Jahre 25 Millionen Euro in die Entdeckung von Parfum in Europa zu investieren. Deine Rolle Scento betreibt einen eigenen Shop auf Next.js und ein eigenes Commerce-Backend auf Medusa, Node.js, TypeScript und PostgreSQL, dazu einen selbst gebauten Checkout auf Stripe. Diese Plattform trägt den Verkauf von Parfumproben, saisonalen Produkten wie dem Parfum-Adventskalender und Geschenksets in ganz Europa. Als Staff Engineer prägst du ihre Architektur. Du setzt technische Standards, sorgst dafür, dass Seiten schnell laden und Zahlungen zuverlässig durchlaufen, und hebst das Niveau des gesamten Engineering-Teams. Erfolg heißt: Wir liefern schneller, die Plattform bleibt stabil, wenn der Traffic steigt, und die besten Ideen aus Produkt und Growth landen ohne Reibung live. Deine Aufgaben Du gestaltest die Architektur von Scentos Commerce-Plattform: Next.js-Storefront und Medusa-Backend auf PostgreSQL. Du baust und härtest unseren eigenen Checkout mit Stripe, inklusive mehrerer Währungen und Sprachen. Du führst bei Performance (Core Web Vitals), Zuverlässigkeit, Observability und Sicherheit. Du legst Engineering-Standards fest, reviewst Code und förderst andere Engineers im Alltag. Du arbeitest direkt mit Produkt, Growth und Operations an Features mit großer Wirkung. Du entscheidest pragmatisch zwischen Geschwindigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit und machst deine Abwägungen für alle nachvollziehbar. Dein Profil Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung mit produktiven Websystemen, mehrere davon auf Staff- oder Principal-Level. Expertenwissen in TypeScript, React und Next.js sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Node.js und PostgreSQL. Erfahrung mit Zahlungen, Headless Commerce oder E-Commerce mit hohem Traffic. Fließend Englisch. Was wir bieten Ein Gehalt am oberen Ende des Marktes plus ein jährlicher Leistungsbonus. Remote-freundlich innerhalb der EU, mit Büros in Paris (Place Vendôme) und Berlin. Ein großzügiges monatliches Parfum-Budget, um den gesamten Katalog zu entdecken. Ein persönliches Lernbudget von 2.500 € pro Jahr für Kurse, Konferenzen und Bücher. Die Ausstattung deiner Wahl und ein Homeoffice-Budget. 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr, zusätzlich zu den gesetzlichen Feiertagen. Echte Verantwortung und schnelle Entscheidungen in einem Unternehmen, das in Europa rasant wächst. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


About the role

You're the local face of People at Legora: bringing local expertise, judgement and a strong understanding of employment practices to support employees and managers through a range of people matters. You will provide local advisory support, run local casework from start to finish, fill process and policy gaps, and make sure the employee experience in your market is accurate, timely and well handled. This is a hands-on, operational role and a strong launchpad for your next step. You'll be close enough to the business to understand how each function really works, trusted to make real judgment calls on the ground, and sharp enough to know when something needs a specialist instead. Sitting within People Operations, you will act as an escalation for our People Operations Specialists, providing guidance and resolving matters that require local interpretation, judgement or a more tailored approach

You'll partner closely with Employee Relations & Compliance, who own our jurisdictional frameworks, create consistent standards, and provide specialist expertise for complex, contested or legally sensitive matters. You'll also work alongside our People Business Partners, sharing local insights and supporting the effective delivery of people initiatives and organisational changes within your local market.


What you'll own

  • Provide practical advice to employees, managers and People Operations colleagues on local employment practices, policies and people matters that require interpretation or judgement.

  • Running local cases from start to finish within the scope of your certification, including absence management, ongoing performance concerns and restructuring conversations, with each one properly scoped, documented and closed

  • Handling intake for leave, accommodation and absence requests, resolving what's routine and recognizing what needs to go further

  • Building out local process and policy, and ensuring people programs effectively land in your market.

  • Identify opportunities to improve local processes, employee experiences and ways of working, collaborating with other People teams to implement improvements.

  • Applying your market's jurisdiction playbook accurately and consistently, and flagging where it doesn't fit local reality

  • Recognizing the moment a matter becomes formal, contested or legally sensitive, and handing it off the same day with everything the next person needs to pick it up seamlessly

  • Keeping your certification and calibration current so your casework meets the same standard as every other market

  • Work closely with People Business Partners and Employee Relations & Compliance, sharing local trends, recurring issues and emerging risks to inform broader people decisions and improvements.


What success looks like

  • Employees and managers get fast, consistent, local support without having to wait on anyone

  • Every case you run is well documented and would stand up to close scrutiny

  • Handoffs are clean and immediate, and nothing formal or legally sensitive stays with you longer than it should

  • Patterns you spot locally, such as a recurring issue or a risk building in one team, are raised early with both Employee Relations & Compliance and the relevant People Partner, before they become bigger problems

  • You're a trusted, visible presence in your market: the person people choose to go to, not a channel they're told to use


Who you are

  • Experience in an HR, People Operations or HR generalist role, ideally with some exposure to employee relations casework

  • A good understanding of local employment practices, employee relations and HR policies, with the ability to apply these in real-world situations.

  • Able to stay neutral and steady under pressure, including with senior stakeholders

  • Sound judgment on when to act and when to escalate; you'd rather flag early than guess

  • Organized and detail-oriented, with documentation clear enough that someone else could pick it up cold

  • Motivated by where this role can lead, with a genuine interest in growing

  • Comfortable working within a defined playbook while bringing your own judgment to how it's applied

title: Product Engineer / Builder
description: Why this role exists Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel. Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started. What you'll do Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Talk to customers, build across the whole stack, and ship to production. Turn what AI can do today into features that procurement and engineering teams use every day. You’re done when it drives revenue, not when it’s merged. Don’t wait for a PRD. What we mean by Builder Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better. We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.” How we build - The Tacto Engineer Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other to. Wear the customer’s shoes. Ship fast, finish fully. Sweat the details. Get 1% better every week. No lone wolves. Use AI as leverage, not a crutch. Read the full version at en.tacto.ai/engineering . If it reads like the way you already work, you’ll fit in here. Who we're looking for Hungry, creative, AI pilled engineers at every level of seniority who care more about the result than the craft. You have your own ideas and act on them, whether that’s something you started, a side project, or a feature nobody asked for that turned out to matter. You’ve shipped real production software in a modern product team. Experience with B2B SaaS or data products is a plus. You work in Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents every day, and you’ve built something with them that wouldn’t exist otherwise. You go deep in modern Python (FastAPI, async, SQL) or TypeScript/React/Next.js, and you’re happy to work anywhere in the stack. You’ve built AI features into a product, or you’re obsessively learning how. You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building. Stack Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and ClickHouse on the backend. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Storybook on the frontend. GitHub, Linear, and Figma for everything around it. For AI, whatever ships fastest. How we work We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes, not hours. Trust is high and feedback is direct. Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 26 + 4 vacation days, Wellpass fitness membership, JobRad bike leasing, company pension plan, and a childcare (Kita) subsidy. Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau , da du technische Kundengespräche führst, Entscheidungen im Team abstimmst und Dokumentationen auf Deutsch erstellst. Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team aus IT- und Security-Fachkräften. Direkter Austausch mit Kunden und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen mitzugestalten. Raum, wiederverwendbare Sicherheitsstandards, Automatisierungen und Dokumentationen aufzubauen. Deine Bewerbung Bewirb dich direkt über diese Anzeige mit deinem Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Überblick über zwei relevante Projekte – möglichst eines mit Azure und eines mit AWS. Beschreibe dabei jeweils deine eigene Aufgabe und die von dir umgesetzten Sicherheitsmaßnahmen. Nenne uns außerdem deinen möglichen Eintrittstermin.
