title: Customer Success Manager, SME & Growth
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact Own the first 90 days of the customer journey for new French customers, bringing them to their target level of activity as quickly as possible through clear plans, hands-on product configuration and fast blocker removal. You’ll lead onboarding from first KYC approval, working closely with Account Executives, Account Managers, KYC, Support, Risk and Product across a portfolio of customers with different levels of complexity. You’ll help customers configure and activate accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts, while managing a proactive portfolio of partner-referred customers. Take ownership of each customer from first KYC approval, with a clear plan, milestones, owners and the revenue target defined at signature. Adapt the onboarding approach to the deal: use a scaled motion for smaller deals, a high-touch approach for larger ones, and partner with the Account Manager on enterprise onboardings. Guide customers through account set-up, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts based on their use case. Remove blockers quickly by coordinating with KYC, Support, Risk and Product, while keeping communication clear and proactive. Hand customers over to the Account Manager at day 90 with documented account status, adoption level and expansion signals. Reduce the time between first KYC approval and first live transaction. Bring each customer to the revenue target set at signature and spot at-risk onboardings early, escalating with context, impact and a proposed solution. Run a proactive, scaled motion for partner-referred customers, including onboarding follow-up, usage monitoring and risk detection. Keep partners informed about the progress of their referred customers and hand accounts that grow in value or complexity to the Account Manager. Contribute to onboarding playbooks, checklists and standard configurations by customer type. Keep Salesforce and onboarding tracking accurate and up to date, turning recurring friction into process improvements. You’ll work from our Paris office a minimum of three days per week. What we're looking for Essentials Experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success or a comparable post-sale delivery role. Experience working in a high-pace, high-volume environment, handling multiple onboardings in parallel while maintaining quality and deadlines. Hands-on experience configuring a product with customers. A strong understanding of financial flows such as payments, FX, payouts, cards, invoicing or reconciliation, and the ability to speak credibly to Finance and Operations teams. A track record measured on customer outcomes such as activation, usage and time-to-live, rather than activity. Fluency in French and professional English. The ability to learn complex products quickly, explain them simply and work across teams without direct authority. A proactive, resilient and hands-on way of working. Preferred Experience in fintech, payments, banking, FX or spend management. Accounting or finance knowledge. Experience with partner-referred customers. Familiarity with Salesforce and usage data. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You treat setbacks as information. You get back up quickly. You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability. Learn more about your team SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

How you'll make impact

  • Guide customers through account set-up, payments, FX, cards, Spend and payouts based on their use case.

  • Remove blockers quickly by coordinating with KYC, Support, Risk and Product, while keeping communication clear and proactive.

  • Hand customers over to the Account Manager at day 90 with documented account status, adoption level and expansion signals.

  • Reduce the time between first KYC approval and first live transaction.

  • A strong understanding of financial flows such as payments, FX, payouts, cards, invoicing or reconciliation, and the ability to speak credibly to Finance and Operations teams.

  • A track record measured on customer outcomes such as activation, usage and time-to-live, rather than activity.

  • Fluency in French and professional English.

  • The ability to learn complex products quickly, explain them simply and work across teams without direct authority.

  • A proactive, resilient and hands-on way of working.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, FX or spend management.

  • Accounting or finance knowledge.

  • Experience with partner-referred customers.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and usage data.

You'll thrive here if

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mirakl:</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.<br><br>Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).<br><br>With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.</p> <p>For more information: <a href="http://www.mirakl.com">www.mirakl.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Mirakl in Numbers:</strong></p> <ul> <li>🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40</li> <li>👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo</li> <li>🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France</li> <li>⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <p>Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.</p> <p>Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:</p> <ul> <li>💡<strong> Work Hard Together:</strong> Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success</li> <li>🏆 <strong>Get Things Done: </strong>&nbsp;We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results</li> <li>🚀 <strong>Go Above &amp; Beyond:</strong>&nbsp; We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence</li> <li>🎓 <strong>Succeed Through Expertise:</strong> Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture</li> <li>🤝 <strong>Satisfy &amp; Empower Clients:</strong> We're committed to our clients' success</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>About the job</strong></h2> <p>Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.<br><br>You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.</p> <p>This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.</p> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <h2><strong>Why Now, Why Mirakl</strong><strong><br></strong></h2> <p>Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.</p> <p>At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.</p> <p>You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.</p> <h2><strong><br>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <h4><strong>1. Design &amp; Build AI Systems</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.</li> <li>Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.</li> <li>Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.</li> <li>Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Integrate Across the Stack</strong></p> <ul> <li>Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.</li> <li>Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.</li> <li>Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.</li> <li>Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Iterate for Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.</li> <li>Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.</li> <li>Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.</li> <li>Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4. Ensure Quality, Security &amp; Reliability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.</li> <li>Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.</li> <li>Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>5. Drive Adoption &amp; Enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.</li> <li>Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.</li> <li>Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.</li> <li>Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our stack and tools</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Languages: </strong>Python and SQL</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>AI Stack:&nbsp;</strong>OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Agentic &amp; Retrieval: </strong>LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases</p> </li> <li><strong>Infrastructure: </strong>AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Makes You Successful</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems</li> <li>Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products</li> <li>Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact</li> <li>Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success Metrics</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Product adoption and business impact</li> <li>Performance and reliability of AI systems</li> <li>Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You'll Love This Job If you have&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields</li> <li>Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals</li> <li>Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents</li> <li>Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems</li> <li>Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance</li> <li>Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English</li> <li>Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products</li> </ul> <p>Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!</p> <h2><strong>Want to join us? Here is our process&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.</li> <li>An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.</li> <li>2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.</em></p> <p><em>As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in English and <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/fr-FR/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in French.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our </em><a href="https://info.mirakl.com/ai-guidelines-for-candidates-and-interviews" target="_blank"><em>AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews</em></a><em>.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area or Barcelona

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steer Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

🎯 Your mission

As a member of the Strategy & planning team, your mission is to work closely with business teams and C-Level alaners to:

  • Build our business plan to exponentially increase Alan's enterprise value - profitable growth, margin expansion, cost efficiency. This includes deep-dives on go-to-market, on pricing & margin steering, on resource allocation, and on levers to increase our operating leverage.

  • Monitor Alan’s financial and operational performance to understand the value drivers, the opportunities, adjustments to bring to our plan. This implies a strong link with Finance production to build and automate monthly deep-dives

  • Steer performance through framing and implementing high-impact initiatives (e.g. procurement tool, pricing) and driving some punctual explorations (e.g. M&A, transformative partnerships, competitive intelligence)

  • Contribute to our investors relations and financing. This includes preparing Board meetings, fundraising, external communications.

To support the above, you will build, improve, maintain best-in-class tools for financial planning and performance monitoring, hand-in-hand with the Data, Business and Finance teams. This includes BP, monitoring dashboards, selection and implementation of third party tools where relevant.

You will also work closely with the Finance Operations teams, notably to produce and interpret our monthly financial performance, and on specific projects.

⚙️ Qualifications ⚙️

Must have

  • >1y experience in Management consulting or Investment Banking or similar experience at a top tech scale up

  • Excellence in Financial modeling

  • Excellent fluency in both English and French.

  • Passion/strong interest for getting close to other teams, to understand the operational details of their work and support them

    • Business (Sales, Operations, Insurance)

    • Data (support in defining metrics to build & monitor)

  • Experience in working with C-Levels

  • Being hands on: with our distributed ownership culture, you will drive projects end-to-end, from framing to building/implementing the tools, and communication

  • Thrive in exciting, high-intensity environment

Nice to have

  • Experience in Scale-up, SaaS, Insurance companies

  • SQL fluency

  • Accounting knowledge

For this role we are looking to hire within the C0-C1 level range.

 

🌍 How we work

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but the position remains Paris-based

 

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

description: Lieu :    Lyon                                                                           Date souhaitée de démarrage :  11/01/2027 Durée :  6 mois                                                              « S’engager aux côtés d’HI, c’est agir pour venir en aide aux populations vulnérables que nous soutenons sur le terrain. Pour mener à bien cette mission, nous recherchons des étudiants motivés et prêts à mettre leur énergie au service d’une cause qui a du sens » HI, Humanité & Inclusion est une organisation de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables, elle agit et témoigne, pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels, pour améliorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.   Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens.    Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org   OBJECTIFS DU STAGE : Le stage se fera au sein du service Sensibilisation - Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, dans le cadre des missions quotidiennes du service avec un large volet dédié à l’organisation des déploiements des Pyramides de chaussures. You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for France, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business.

Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps.

This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI.

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for France, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

  • Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

  • Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to French customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

  • Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

  • Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

  • Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

  • Establish Notion as a visible force in the French ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

  • Represent the voice of French customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

  • Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

  • Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.

A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in France and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent.

You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow.

  • Deep knowledge of the French enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics across all market segments (commercial, midmarket and enterprise)

  • Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams.

  • Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics.

  • Agency & Urgency: experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment.

  • Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products.

  • Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes.

  • Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process.

  • Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative.

  • Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product.

Content is how that shift happens, one piece at a time: the case study a CIO forwards to their COO, the white paper a board reads before a steering committee, the article an engineer shares because it is precise.

You will be our first Content Manager and reporting to the head of marketing. You'll own the global content strategy and production, hands in hands with the brand, lead gen and product marketing stakeholders, from thought leadership to customer proof.

Our brand stance is that of a pragmatic visionary: bold on vision, precise and evidence-led on capability. You'll write and edit in both registers, a bold "vision voice" and a precise "capability voice", so that every piece speaks the language of the boardroom and holds up to the scrutiny of a CTO/builder.

You'll work hand in hand with Product Marketing, Growth, Research, Sales, our FDE teams and Communications, and with our external agencies and freelancers.

raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

title: Junior Product Designer - UI/UX
description: You turn complex manufacturing data into interfaces factory teams rely on every day, working side by side with our engineers. Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world. We serve the world's top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity. WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? You’ll join our small design team and work directly with our engineers. At first you’ll focus on UI: building screens, components and flows for our platform, and helping our design system grow. Over time you’ll take on larger parts of the product end to end. This is what you’ll do: Turn flows and concepts into detailed production-ready screens. Create and maintain components in Figma, keep them in sync with what’s in code, and notice when patterns start to drift. Pair with developers, review builds, and make quick trade-offs when something doesn’t fit the sprint. Your designs ship; you don’t just hand off Figma files. When a shortcut hurts the experience, you say so, explain why, and propose an alternative. And you know when good enough is good enough. Join customer calls and factory visits, test ideas with our forward deployed engineers, and bring what you learn back into the product. Help where a startup needs it: website updates, sales decks and marketing visuals now and then. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you're passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you. You don’t need to have done it all. We can teach you manufacturing, our product, and a lot about designing complex B2B software. We can’t teach you to care about the details, or to be curious about how things work. Must-haves: You’re fluent in English and comfortable with changing priorities. You know when to be scrappy and when to be thorough. You have 1–3 years of professional experience designing digital products. Internships and working-student roles count if you shipped real work. You have strong UI craft and have hands-on experience with a design system. You’re fluent in Figma (components, variants, auto layout, variables) and comfortable using AI tools for quick iterations and prototypes. You enjoy working closely with developers and understand enough about frontend to design things that can be built. You can explain and stand behind your design decisions, and you change your mind when someone has a better argument. You’re curious about users, technology and how things get made, and you actively look for feedback so you can grow. Bonus: Experience with B2B SaaS, dashboards or data-heavy products WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. You’ll work alongside two senior designers, get regular design critiques, and sit close to the engineers who build what you design. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. Additionally, we offer: Performance-based career & growth paths On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation Flexible parental leave Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech. HOW TO APPLY Send us your CV and a portfolio with 2–3 case studies, at least one showing detailed UI work. Tell us briefly what you did yourself and what the team did. Our interview process includes a short design challenge during the on-site, so you can show us how you work. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Your primary purpose will be to lead medical excellence initiatives across the Medical Affairs organization, such as scientific communications, field medical, training and other medical excellence priorities as the business evolves. This role requires effective collaboration with Medical Directors, cross-functional colleagues and external experts to ensure scientifically rigorous, consistent and compliant communications and practices. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare&nbsp;disease, and&nbsp;develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll&nbsp;ask&nbsp;"why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical &amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You'll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>You are a strategic IT partner with deep technical experience supporting BridgeBio's International organization across Commercial and Medical Affairs, G&amp;A, and Supply Chain functions. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports: BridgeBio's operating model delivers International IT work through external vendors and consultants, and this role provides both the strategic direction and the hands-on technical expertise needed to design, direct, and validate that work. You report to the Executive Director, IT Enterprise Applications in the US, and partner closely with International business leaders and US-based IT counterparts.</p> <p>You will own the International application and technology roadmap and business relationship, for Commercial and Medical Affairs systems including Veeva CRM, Databricks, and Analytics, while ensuring alignment with enterprise owned platforms managed by US teams. For core enterprise systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Coupa, Malbek CLM, and Workday HRIS, you will act as the International liaison, ensuring local business needs, regulatory requirements, and market nuances are represented in both strategy and system design. You will direct and technically oversee the consultants and partners who execute this work.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary strategic IT partner to International business leadership, aligning technology strategy with business priorities, operational objectives, and long-term growth plans</li> <li>Shape and execute a multi-year technology roadmap for BridgeBio International, applying hands-on familiarity with Veeva CRM and data/analytics platforms (Databricks) to evaluate technical design decisions and identify digital transformation opportunities through data, automation, AI, and enterprise technologies</li> <li>Own end-to-end demand management, prioritization, and delivery of International IT initiatives, including business case development and investment prioritization, ensuring alignment with business strategy and cross-platform standards, and monitoring performance through KPIs and value realization metrics</li> <li>Own raw.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. In this role, you will lead the physical product design of hardware assemblies, mechanical housings, custom structures, and precision mechanisms, guiding products through CAD design, drafting, prototype verification, and industrialisation.

From day one, you will own the transition of concepts into production-ready physical hardware. You will maintain strict product data management standards, apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, run thermal and stress analyses, work with suppliers across various manufacturing processes, and perform hands-on prototype assembly and testing.

What You Will Do

  • CAD Design & Drafting: Create clean, fully constrained CAD models, multi-part assembly layouts, and detailed engineering drawings following formal geometric dimensioning and tolerancing standards.

  • Product Data & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change requests, update bill of materials data, maintain material libraries, and enforce configuration controls in digital product data systems.

  • Prototype Assembly & Verification: Build physical prototypes, test assembly sequences, verify fit and tolerance stack-ups, and establish unit build procedures.

  • Environmental & Stress Analysis: Perform structural, thermal, vibration, and mechanical shock simulations to ensure hardware survives harsh operational environments.

  • Manufacturing & Supplier Integration: Work closely with suppliers to optimize designs for production methods such as CNC machining, stamping, pressing, forging, casting, and injection molding.

  • Cross-Functional Interface Management: Collaborate with electronics, simulation, testing, and systems engineering teams to define physical interface control documents, packaging requirements, and technical datasheets.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • CAD & Drafting Experience: Strong proficiency in production CAD environments with experience applying formal drafting standards such as ASME or ISO GD&T.

  • Product Data Management: Practical experience with configuration management practices, engineering change notices, and product data systems such as Siemens Teamcenter or similar PDM/PLM tools.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management (UK/EU)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>About Summit:</strong></p> <p>Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:</p> <p><strong>Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Colorectal Cancer (CRC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.</em></p> <p></p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Job Title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-size: 10.5pt;">Location: Oxford, UK or Zug, Switzerland or Dublin, Ireland</span></strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview of Role:</strong></p> <p>The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities. The role translates functional strategy into disciplined execution across demand and supply planning, inventory management, packaging and labelling, distribution, returns and destruction, cross-border compliance, and GxP operations. Acting as a key delegate for the Senior Director, the (Associate) Director provides a layer of management for direct reports, establishes clear priorities and performance expectations, develops team capability, and drives operational excellence through standardized processes, meaningful metrics, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Commercial, CMC, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Medical Affairs and Program Management, and oversees external partners including Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), IXRS providers and specialist service providers.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role and Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supports the Senior Director in developing functional strategy, operating plans, budgets, governance and performance objectives across global clinical supply chain activities</li> <li>Leads day-to-day execution for new and ongoing studies and products, ensuring robust forecasting, supply planning, schedule adherence, inventory optimization, global logistics and sustained GxP compliance</li> <li>Serves as a delegate for the Senior Director in cross-functional forums, governance meetings, supplier reviews and issue escalation, providing clear recommendations and ensuring timely follow-through.</li> <li>Manages and develops direct reports, translating functional priorities into individual objectives, balancing workloads, coaching performance, supporting career development and ensuring appropriate succession and capability plans.</li> <li>Creates an effective management layer by coordinating team activities, reinforcing accountability, removing operational barriers and escalating material risks or decisions to the Senior Director.</li> <li>Overseeing the Clinical Supply Management (CSM) team, the Associate Director interprets complex clinical protocols, development plans and commercial demand forecasts, working with CMC and internal and external partners to develop packaging, labelling, supply and resupply strategies, timelines and plans.</li> <li>Supports the accountability of CSM team to oversee packaging, labelling, release, distribution, resupply, returns, reconciliation and destruction activities across global locations</li> <li>Develops and maintains supply project budgets, resource plans and integrated schedules, monitors performance and proactively resolves variances</li> <li>Manages CDMO and service-provider activities from RFP and contracting support through routine operations, troubleshooting, invoicing and performance management using defined KPIs and service expectations</li> <li>Supports IXRS selection, design, set-up, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), implementation and ongoing operational performance as required by IRT Management Team.</li> <li>Drives operational excellence by defining standard work, governance routines, KPIs and dashboards; uses trend and root-cause analysis to improve service, quality, cost, compliance and team productivity</li> <li>Leads continuous-improvement initiatives that streamline and harmonize processes, strengthen inspection readiness and embed sustainable ways of working</li> <li>Supports regulatory submissions, audits and inspections and ensures timely management of SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs within the function</li> <li>Provides continuity of leadership and performs other responsibilities within the function as assigned</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BSc, MSc, engineering or pharmacy degree, or equivalent, with a minimum of 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) environment</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading complex international clinical studies and product supply chains, with broad knowledge of regulatory and GMP requirements for IMP and commercial product packaging and supply</li> <li>Prior people-management experience, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing talent, delegating effectively and managing through others</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executable priorities, operating rhythms, metrics and measurable team outcomes</li> <li>Strong operational-excellence and continuous-improvement capability, including process standardization, KPI management, root-cause analysis and sustainable implementation of improvements</li> <li>Solid understanding of IXRS design specifications, set-up and UAT, together with proficiency in clinical supply planning and forecasting tools</li> <li>Strong project, budget, risk and resource-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality results</li> <li>Expertise in outsourcing, supplier governance, negotiation and performance management</li> <li>Experience building, scaling or improving end-to-end product supply chains and associated business processes</li> <li>Ability to operate as a trusted deputy to the Director, exercise sound judgement within delegated authority and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations</li> <li>Confident communicator able to influence all levels of the organization and build effective relationships with global colleagues, customers and suppliers</li> <li>Able to work independently with complex global problems while fostering inclusion, collaboration, accountability and effective team leadership</li> <li>Agile and resilient in a dynamic organization where priorities may change rapidly</li> <li>Knowledge of the drug development process and applicable FDA, EMA and PMDA expectations, including GMP, GCP, Annex 13 and relevant clinical trial requirements</li> <li>Technically proficient with industry-standard systems and tools and able to use technology, data and industry trends to improve efficiency and decision-making</li> <li>Knowledgeable of and compliant with SOPs, change controls, deviations, investigations and CAPAs</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>This is the pay for this position</p></div><div The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.</p> <p>Summit does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>ABOUT SOTHEBY'S</strong></p> <p>Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.</p></div><p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p> <p>Working closely with the Head of Luxury Division and the Managing Director Switzerland, the role provides meaningful business insights, performance visibility and strategic reporting to support decision-making across the business. The position acts as an enabler to specialists and leadership teams by translating commercial and client data into actionable intelligence, helping identify trends, opportunities and areas of focus.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Client Analytics &amp; Growth Insights</p> <ul> <li>Leverage internal client data and CRM tools to provide visibility on client activity, engagement patterns and growth opportunities across categories.</li> <li>Support specialists and leadership teams by identifying client trends, areas of opportunity and potential cross-category connections.</li> <li>Contribute to client acquisition and development initiatives through data-driven analysis and actionable insights.</li> <li>Analyse client acquisition, retention and reactivation trends to support business planning and prioritization.</li> <li>Develop reporting and insights on key client-related KPIs.</li> <li>Collaborate with global client strategy teams to share best practices and ensure alignment of methodologies and reporting.</li> </ul> <p>Business Performance Analytics &amp; raw.description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately
